messages:
Elaine: FYI — launch posts for Feature X went live across blog, Twitter, and LinkedIn at 09:00 PT. rough engagement numbers in the dashboard look ok but there are a few oddities.
Matt: saw the spikes, but CTR on the hero CTA is ~30% below our benchmark for similar launches. odd.
Zoe: noticed that too. the traffic source breakdown shows a big uptick from referral partners but low conversion there.
Rami: could be an attribution window mismatch. are we using last-touch 7d for the dashboard? that would undercount some multi-touch credit.
Elaine: dashboard is using last_touch_7d for campaign attribution today. MarketingBot: Automated run of weekly_kpi_refresh completed — all cohorts updated.
Jack: tagging @Zoe @Rami — I pulled the segment queries. quick snippet:

```
SELECT source, count(*) as visits, sum(converted) as leads
FROM events
WHERE event_date >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY source
```
Matt: can you add funnel steps? need to see regs -> attends -> demo requests.
Zoe: on it. also seeing webinar reg -> attend conversion is 42% (slightly under target of 50%). registration traffic is heavy from the launch post though.
Rami: another hypothesis: inbound lead routing rules recently changed — UA-tagged leads used to map to SDR queue A, now they go to the generic queue. that could delay outreach and hurt demo conversions.
Elaine: when did routing change? I didn't get a heads up.
Jack: @Elaine change rolled 2026-03-18 by infra runbook update. small script in routing-service swapped priority for ua=partner to queue=generic. I can revert if we want.
Matt: let's not revert blindly. need to quantify impact. can we surface avg time-to-first-contact by source for past 14 days vs prior 14 days?
Zoe: I'll add a card to the dashboard: TTFC_by_source. will include median and 95th pctile.
MarketingBot: New card request logged: TTFC_by_source, owner=Zoe, priority=high.
Rami: for attribution debate — propose we show both last_touch_7d and time_decay_14d side-by-side in the KPI report this week. gives stakeholders both views.
Elaine: agree. also want a short note in the deck explaining the routing change and potential confounders for webinar conversion.
Matt: who can draft the 2-slide explainer? I can take one slide (metrics), @Rami can do the routing impact slide.
Rami: can do. will include a tiny runbook excerpt and suggested rollback criteria.
Zoe: ETA for dashboard updates? I can push the TTFC card and the dual-attrib columns by EOD tomorrow if there are no blockers.
Jack: I'll run a targeted reindex overnight so the new cards compute fast.
Elaine: perfect. action items: Zoe dashboard updates, Matt + Rami slides, Jack keeps an eye on routing script, Elaine will draft the stakeholder blurb. Thanks team :thumbsup:
